==English==
{{wikidata lexeme|L120}}

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|summarise}} {{qualifier|Commonwealth}}
* {{alt|en|sumize|summize|sumise|summise||shortened form via patterns like {{m|en|summate}}, {{m|en|summation}}}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:af|summary|-ize|text=+|tree=1}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈsʌməˌɹaɪz/|a=RP,GA,CA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-summarize.ogg|a=California}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Flame, not lame-summarise.wav|a=Milwaukee,Wisconsin}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|ambitransitive}} To [[prepare]] a [[summary]] of (something).
#: {{syn|en|brief|q1=especially in writing}}
#: {{ux|en|Jim was asked to '''summarize''' the document by Wednesday.}}
# {{lb|en|ambitransitive}} To give a [[recapitulation]] of the [[salient]] [[fact]]s; to [[recapitulate]] or [[review]].
#: {{syn|en|sum up}}
#: {{ux|en|After the meeting, Jim '''summarized''' the major decisions made.}}

====Usage notes====
* Not to be confused with the similar-sounding ''[[summerize]]''.

====Synonyms====
* {{l|en|précis}}

====Derived terms====
{{col|en|missummarize|summarizable|summarization|summarizer|unsummarized}}
